title: TrainingPeaks TSS Workout Type Leaderboard
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout
| stats avg(tss) as avg_value max(tss) as peak_value count as sessions by workout_type
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks workout type values by average and peak training stress score, helping you see where trainingpeaks tss performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which workout type contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `workout_type` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of workout type, average training stress score, and peak training stress score.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which workout type areas give you the strongest trainingpeaks tss results.
